title: [Pytorch] Handle FakeScriptObject in partitioner _size_of to fix dynamic shapes compilation (#186008)
body:
Summary:

The `_size_of` function in `min_cut_rematerialization_partition` crashes with `RuntimeError: Unknown metadata type <class FakeScriptObject>` when `dynamic_shapes=True` is used on models containing ScriptObject parameters (e.g., TBE configs from FBGEMM).

The partitioner already handles `FakeScriptObject` in 4 other places in the same file (node classification, weight assignment, saved value extraction) but `_size_of` was missed. ScriptObjects have no tensor memory footprint, so returning 0 bytes is the correct behavior, consistent with all other `FakeScriptObject` handling in the file.

This bug blocks using `dynamic=True` with `torch.compile` on models that contain ScriptObject parameters, which is needed for SimpleFSDP memory optimization on large recommendation models.

Test Plan:
Added `test_size_of_fake_script_object` in `test_aotdispatch.py` that creates a graph node with `FakeScriptObject` metadata and verifies `_size_of` returns 0 instead of crashing.

```
buck2 test fbcode//caffe2/test/functorch:test_aotdispatch -- -r test_size_of_fake_script_object
```
